children: , to raise about $7.9M by selling shares and stock warrants to the public.
The company is selling 10.5 million shares, with each share paired with two warrants (Series B-1 and Series B-2) for a combined price of $0.75 per share and warrant set.

Both Series B-1 and Series B-2 warrants carry an exercise price of $0.75 per share and are exercisable immediately upon issuance. The Series B-1 warrants expire five years from issuance, while the Series B-2 warrants expire in 24 months.

Laser Photonics intends to use the net proceeds to advance research and development for its industrial and defense laser technologies, fund potential strategic acquisitions, and support general working capital needs.
The transaction is scheduled to close on or about September 14, 2026.
